posts.en:
dsh-mobile-css is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Mobile adaptation for the DSH Web UI: compact typography, full-width composer with caret fix, drawer sidebar with overlay-close, two-page settings flow, responsive tables and stats, safe touch targets.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-19fd5bacb018f65efebb.html
